methodSections.heading: Cashew Carbonara Sauce
steps: Peel away the outer layer of the garlic while keeping the bulbs whole. With a sharp knife remove the top of each bulb revealing the individual cloves.
Place on a oven tray, drizzle with olive oil, cover with foil and roast at 200°C (400°F) for around 30 minutes or until the cloves feel soft when pressed.
Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves from the skins and set aside.
In a food processor blend 2 cups of water with the cashews until smooth. Add the roasted garlic and blend together.
Transfer the cashew/garlic mix to a saucepan, add the remaining water, stir together and bring to a boil. Add the coconut milk, salt and pepper.
Mix the cornstarch with a splash of water to create a slurry, stir into the sauce, reduce the heat and simmer until the sauce thickens. Season to taste.

methodSections.heading: Coconut 'Bacon' Chips
steps: Spread coconut flakes evenly around a baking tray, drizzle the tamari, liquid smoke and maple syrup over and mix well.
Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until they reach your desired crunch.

methodSections.heading: Pasta
steps: Cook and then drain the pasta.
In a large fry pan heat a splash of olive oil and sauté the diced tofu for roughly a minute.
Add the peas, season with salt and pepper and sauté for roughly another 30 seconds.
Add the Cashew Carbonara Sauce and heat to a simmer.
Plate in a pasta bowl, sprinkle with Coconut 'Bacon' Chips and top with a small bunch of pea shoots.
